title: decrypt.rs: stale doc says KARI not yet implemented
description: decrypt() doc comment (line 36-37) still says 'KARI (ECDH key agreement, KeyAgreeRecipientInfo) is not yet implemented.' KARI was implemented in the prior session. The stale doc misleads callers into thinking ECDH decryption is unsupported. Any user reading the crate docs will miss the feature.
